title: Massachusetts Schedule V prescription refill limits
rule_summary: A Massachusetts Schedule V prescription may not be refilled more than five times or later than six months after the prescription was issued.
exam_relevance: Massachusetts applies a five-refill and six-month framework to Schedule V prescriptions in addition to the federal CIII-IV rule.
common_confusions: The federal five-refill and six-month text in 21 CFR 1306.22 expressly addresses Schedules III and IV; Massachusetts separately applies the limits to Schedule V.
Unused authorized refills do not survive the six-month time limit.
verification_notes: Verified against the current compiled Massachusetts regulation on 2026-08-13.
